audio.title: Paper Procession
audio.composition: Original fixed D-major 24-bar theme: main melody, variation and spacious section; warm bass, fixed plucked harmonics and scene-specific wood/clap accents. All synthesized locally.
audio.preferences: Application persists settings; AudioEngine does not write run saves or localStorage.
audio.lifecycle: One context after unlock(), one music scheduler; setSuspended(true) stops pending voices and suspends the context. Foreground resumes the same context. Muting stops the loop. No scene DOM listeners.

operations.invalid(): Refused action after a readable reason.
operations.playHand(): PlayHand succeeds, immediately before committed-result presentation.
operations.joker(chainIndex): A real Joker trace event; pitch rises only to the finite cap.
operations.multiplier(add|multiply,index): The corresponding real +M or multiplication trace event.
operations.score(0|1|2): Final committed score enters the total; the caller chooses the relative reward tier.
operations.success()/failure(): Actual stage/run outcome once, without render/resize repetition.

audio.listeningLimits: Timings are calculated schedules, not measured device latency or human listening. Three fixed sections reduce immediate repetition; synthesized instrument body, mobile balance, fatigue, loop seam and fast overlap remain NOT_RUN for listening. Finite pitch and 32-voice cap remain. Earlier fake WebAudio checks apply to the prior eight-bar revision; this music extension was typechecked, not re-audited by that probe.
